text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] host=hosted-runtime-gpu-pool-3 kvcache.memory_usage=92% spikes past 90% x5 in 2m. continuous-batching queue depth increasing. Pager dispatched to #incidents. pd_incident:PD12345

 dinesh: taking pager. looking into spike, pulling recent logs.

 alice: saw increased 5xxs and elevated tail latency for /v1/generate from a small subset of sessions. Possibly long prompts causing KV growth. tagging ben.

 ben: @dinesh can you run: kubectl logs -n hosted runtime-pool-3 --since=5m | rg "kvcache: alloc" -A2

 dinesh: ran logs, paste:

 ```
 [kvcache] alloc session=shard-42 id=abc123 size=1.9GB prefix=repeat(50x)
 [kvcache] prefetch depth=64 continuous_batch window_ms=100
 [kvcache] total_alloc=73GB
 ```

 dinesh: hmm prefetch depth looks high (64). continuous_batch window at 100ms is combining lots of long contexts -> kv explosion.

 carol: customer-impact: 3 high-volume customers reporting degraded tail latency, one saw 502 spike ~12%.

 infra-oncall: propose immediate mitigations: 1) lower continuous_batch.window_ms -> 20ms 2) set kvcache.prefetch_depth to 4 3) enable eviction soft-limit at 80%

 dinesh: applying changes now (rolling config patch).

 ben: FYI running hotfix script:

 ```
 ./ops/run-config-patch --cluster hosted-runtime --pool gpu-pool-3 \
   --set continuous_batch.window_ms=20 \
   --set kvcache.prefetch_depth=4 \
   --set kvcache.eviction.soft_limit_pct=80
 ```

 dinesh: patch applied, rolling restart on 2/6 replicas (gradual). Monitoring.

 incident-bot: config-patch PD12345 applied by dinesh at 2026-03-17T18:12:05Z

 alice: metrics already trending down: kvcache.total_alloc -> 40GB in 3m, 5xx rate decreasing.

 carol: customer comms: drafting note to engineering CSMs, no broad outage but sustained latencies. cc @support

 dinesh: still seeing one noisy session: session id=abc123. blocked it with per-session prefetch cap.

 ben: can we add runtime fix to prevent per-token prefix replication? I'll open PR to cap replication multiplicative factor.

 infra-oncall: agreed. create follow-up ticket and assign to eng-runtime. set pager duty status to acknowledged -> monitoring.

 dinesh: handing off to ben for follow-ups, summary: hotfix lowered batch window & prefetch depth, enabled eviction, isolated noisy session. No further customer-impact after mitigation. Next oncall: ben

 ben: taking handoff. will own postmortem and follow-up patch. cc: @alice @carol

 pagerduty-bot: Incident PD12345 status=resolved->monitoring. Time to resolution: ~27m. Postmortem required.
